facts.text: I asked about how the street murals of Banksy and other artists comment on cultural and social divisions in contemporary society.
I noticed that Banksy's murals often feature rats.
I appreciate the way Banksy uses his art to bring attention to important social issues.
I asked for other artists who do similar work to Banksy by using art to raise awareness about important social issues.
I asked where to go see street art in person.
I have always wanted to see more street art in person.
I think I might start with Melbourne because it sounds like it has a vibrant street art scene.
I have always wondered how street artists create their murals.
I asked whether street artists just show up with paint or whether there is planning involved.
I asked whether artists ever face legal issues when painting in public spaces without permission.
